verdict.rationale: IRCC's own pages say you can 'Apply for a work permit, extend a work permit', and they list online accounts (GCKey), an Electronic travel authorization (eTA) and an online status check. Together these point to online applications, but none of the cited pages explicitly says the core application can be submitted and completed online. missing for 10: explicit first-party statement that applications (work permit, Start-up Visa) are submitted online end to end, description of the online submission and payment flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: Apply for a work permit, extend a work permit or hire a foreign worker.
Accounts (GCKey, representatives, employers and more), biometrics, forms, change address
Electronic travel authorization (eTA), visitor visa, extend your visit
